competitive_implication: The WordPress brochure is the local default. Shops that move first to a converting site leapfrog the whole market, because the bar is a contact page.
joke_candidates: The stack is WordPress, hope, and a prayer.
Somewhere a plugin updated and nobody knows what it does anymore.
Their digital transformation was a new theme in 2019.
The website runs on WordPress, seventeen plugins, and the eternal optimism that someone will call.
Somewhere a slider plugin is doing all the heavy lifting for the entire local economy.
mechanism: WordPress plus a theme plus plugins is the cheapest way to look established. It produces brochures by default; conversion machinery is never in the default install.
observation: The confirmed-CMS shops in the map run WordPress brochure sites with no conversion machinery beyond forms.
opportunity: Website revamp for non-technical owners with weak sites (existing PING Social angle): compose booking, text-back, and review capture into the existing WordPress rather than rebuilding.
public_safe_text: WordPress confirmed on 3 of the 19 mapped shops, all running brochure-style sites with no observed booking or chat.
risk_notes: Low. Clowns the technology stack, which is a commodity, not the businesses.
